name: marker
title: Marker
description: A quiet caption line in a conversation or list: a date between two rules, a ruled heading, or where unread messages begin.
usage: Use to mark a point in a stream: a day (separator), the start of unread messages (unread), a small heading over a group (border), or a note (default). Put a 14px glyph in MarkerIcon and the words in MarkerContent.

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/shell/support-chat.tsx (its caption line)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
